name: print-social-purple-folders-and-cartoon-selfie-course-cover
title: Beige post with blue slanted banners, three lilac folders, a pixel cursor and a cartoon selfie girl
whatItIs: A grainy beige portrait with two slanted blue banners with cream caps, three big lilac desktop folders with labels, a pixel cursor pointing at one, and a 3D animated-style girl taking a selfie at the lower right, with a handle at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Friendly and orderly; folders turn course benefits into files.
techniques: Show benefits as labelled desktop folders.
Use a cursor to imply clicking.
Add a cartoon character for personality.

vocabulary.definition: A folder icon labelling one benefit.
A title strip with angled ends.
